description: Agent Travel: submit the cancellation terms on a booking with what the booking states and any cancellation: the fare rules’ terms with whether the ticket is refundable, what a timely cancellation returns (cash, credit or nothing), the hours before departure by which it must be cancelled, the cancellation fee and currency, the days a credit stays usable and how cancelling part of the trip is treated (prorated, repriced or not allowed); the terms stated on the booking with the cancel-by deadline, refund form, fee, credit expiry, partial treatment and text; the original departure; what was paid; and optionally the cancellation with when it was made, whether only part of the trip was cancelled, the refund form and amount, the fee charged and the credit expiry. The signed report gives the terms, what the booking states, every point with the rules beside the booking and whether the booking states more or less than the rules give, with the cancel-by deadline worked out from the departure, and the cancellation with whether it came inside the deadline, what was owed, what was returned and the credit expiry the rules give, and counts them, and names misstated cancellation terms: a cancel-by deadline later than the rules give, a cash refund stated where the rules return credit or nothing, a fee stated lower than the rules, a credit expiry stated later than the rules and a timely cancellation paid short in amount, form or credit life; then no deadline stated, a credit with no expiry named, no partial treatment stated and terms stated more strictly than the rules, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No refund form, no deadline in the rules, no departure, no stated terms or no record of what was paid leaves the terms unverified. This reads one booking’s cancellation terms against its fare rules: a refund claim against a merchant’s policy is wever_refund-eligibility-check, a vendor’s refund terms as a remedy path are wever_vendor-refund-check and a guarantee against its terms is wever_guarantee-evidence-check. Verdict travel_cancellation_misstated, travel_cancellation_partial, travel_cancellation_unverified or travel_cancellation_as_stated. POST /api/travel-cancellation-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.

cancelled_at.description: A date or time with its offset, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

part.description: Whether only part of the trip was cancelled.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

cancel_by.description: The cancel-by deadline the booking states, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

credit_expires.description: The credit expiry the booking names, such as 2026-12-02.

text.description: The cancellation terms as stated on the booking.

cancel_by_hours.description: Hours before departure by which a cancellation must be made.

credit_valid_days.description: Days a credit stays usable from the cancellation.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

partial.description: How cancelling part of a trip is treated.

name: wever_travel-cancellation-check
title: Travel cancellation check
